title: Task-management Web application
source_request: Build a small Web application for managing personal tasks.
requirements: Users can create, view, update, delete, and filter persisted tasks.
The application provides useful validation and not-found responses.
The application starts locally from a clean checkout.

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can create a task with a required title.
Tasks remain available after an application restart.
All fixed tests and static checks pass.

constraints: Use Python 3.12, FastAPI, Jinja2, SQLite, and pytest.
Do not require a hosted service.
assumptions: The first benchmark targets one local user.
